entire-repo.description: Every file in the PR diff (default).

airflow.focus: Review as an Airflow and Astro specialist: DAG and task correctness, scheduling and idempotency, top-level code that slows DAG parsing, provider and operator usage, connections and secrets handling, and dependency or runtime-image compatibility.

data-engineer.description: Everything a data engineer cares about: Airflow/Astro files, SQL, and dbt.
data-engineer.focus: Review as a data engineer: in addition to Airflow and Astro correctness, check SQL for correctness, join fan-out, NULL handling, partition and incremental-load logic, idempotent re-runs, query cost and performance, and dbt model, test, and materialization choices. Treat schema changes as potentially breaking for downstream consumers.

data-platform-engineer.description: Everything a data platform engineer cares about: Airflow/Astro files plus the infrastructure the data platform runs on (Terraform, Kubernetes/Helm, docker-compose).
data-platform-engineer.focus: Review as a data platform engineer: in addition to Airflow and Astro correctness, check the infrastructure the data platform runs on: infrastructure-as-code safety (destructive or replace-forcing changes, state and drift risk), least-privilege IAM, network exposure and secrets handling for storage, warehouse, and cluster resources, Airflow deployment configuration, and resource limits, scaling, and upgrade or rollback behavior.

devops-engineer.description: Everything a DevOps engineer cares about: CI/CD pipelines, containers, deployment manifests, and build scripts.
devops-engineer.focus: Review as a DevOps engineer: CI/CD pipeline correctness (triggers, permissions, caching, concurrency), supply-chain risk (unpinned actions or images, untrusted input in scripts), secrets exposure in pipelines and images, container image hygiene and pinning, shell script safety, and deployment, health-check, and rollback behavior.
